caption: Banditaccia Necropolis, Cerveteri
composition: Etruscan grass-covered tumuli with stone drum walls along quiet dirt paths · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera walks the quiet dirt paths of the Banditaccia necropolis at midday, among the grass-covered Etruscan tumuli. The round mounds with their dry-stone drum walls fill the frame on all sides, the nearest with its dark doorway facing the viewer, while oak trees shade the paths between them. The modelled 23 September 2026, 12:10 sun is high and bright, the green grass and grey stone glowing under a clear pale-blue sky.
